title: Chitin Binding Assay Using Chitin Magnetic Beads
author: Robert Hooftman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8anhsde

steps.title: Prepare binding buffer
steps.instruction: Make 1 L of 1× CBD Column Binding Buffer by mixing: Tris‑HCl 20 mM (adjust pH to 8 with HCl, 2.42 g L⁻¹), NaCl 500 mM (29.22 g L⁻¹), EDTA 1 mM (0.292 g L⁻¹), Tween‑20 0.05 % v/v. Store at room temperature. (500 µL of this buffer will be used per wash.)

steps.title: Resuspend magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Gently mix the 5 mL Chitin Magnetic Beads (New England Biolabs catalog #E8036S) until a uniform suspension is obtained.

steps.title: Aliquot and pre‑wash beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of the bead suspension into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, capture beads with a magnet for 30 s, discard the supernatant, then wash the beads three times with 500 µL of 1× CBD Column Binding Buffer, each wash followed by 30 s magnetic capture and removal of liquid.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 50 µL beads into a 2 mL tube
Place tube on magnet for 30 s and discard supernatant
Wash 1: add 500 µL buffer, mix, magnet 30 s, remove liquid

steps.title: Bind cell supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 200–500 µL of cell supernatant (diluted in 1× CBD Column Binding Buffer if necessary) to the washed beads, mix thoroughly, and incubate with constant agitation for 1 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect unbound supernatant
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 30 s, pipette off the supernatant, and set it aside for later analysis.

steps.title: Wash bound beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 500 µL of 1× CBD Column Binding Buffer; for each wash, add buffer, mix, magnet for 30 s, remove liquid, and retain the wash fractions.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: add 500 µL buffer, mix, magnet 30 s, remove liquid (save fraction)

steps.title: Boil beads in sample buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL SDS‑PAGE sample buffer to the beads and heat at 95 °C for 5 min to release bound proteins.

steps.title: Run protein gel
steps.instruction: Load the saved supernatant, wash fractions, and boiled bead eluate onto a protein gel and run electrophoresis according to standard SDS‑PAGE procedures.
